title: Task
description: Represents a standard cleaning task definition in the global task catalog.

name.description: The name of the task (e.g., 'تنظيف الأرضيات', 'Cleaning Floors').

description.description: A detailed description of what the task involves.

estimatedDuration.description: Estimated duration in minutes to complete this task.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the task was created (Firestore Timestamp).

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the task was last updated (Firestore Timestamp).
